page.overview:
Who is Tauriel?

Tauriel was a Wood-elf of Mirkwood, and captain of the Elven guard of Thranduil's Woodland Realm.

A captain of Thranduil's Elven Guards, Tauriel was a professional in the military and led the Woodland Realm's armed forces. Her parents were killed by Orcs when she was younger and it was hinted that Thranduil looked after her since then. She was a young elf, around the age of 600 (however in some documentaries Peter Jackson said she would be around 1000, in fact giving a specific age of 1,347), and was insightful into the changing nature of Middle-earth. In contrast to Thranduil's portrayed isolationism, Tauriel was interventionist and recognized the growing evils of the world and the need to eradicate them.

Moderately effective in infantry combat, she was proficient in both archery and hand-to-hand combat. Her primary weapons were a reflex bow and two long daggers. She was shown to be an adept archer and marksman, with elvish reflexes and accuracy. She could simultaneously wield her bow and knife in combat, and could fire an arrow quick enough to intervene with the passage of a slower Orc arrow. She was also shown to possess some medical knowledge, being able to treat wounds from poisoned weapons. As a native of the Woodland Realm, she was also a capable tree climber.

Tauriel first appears in as a captain of the Mirkwood Elven Guard. Throughout the film, a subplot develops involving romance between her and Kíli. She rescues Kíli after the Dwarves are ambushed by Giant Spiders as she leads a series of missions to clear Mirkwood of their growing presence. Under Legolas's orders, she and the other guards take the Dwarves back to the Elven cavern fortress and confiscate their weapons. There, Tauriel becomes curious of Kíli's talisman and they talk for a while. Legolas watches them talking from a distance.
